text: たいりょくが　ないときは　やすませて　あげて！

structure.jp: たいりょくが　ないときは
やすませて　あげて！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means letting or making someone do it. やすませて = 'let them rest'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: やすませて　あげて
patterns.explanation: てあげる says you do something as a kindness for someone; ending in て makes it a casual request. やすませて　あげて = 'do them the kindness of letting them rest'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a phrase means 'when'. たいりょくが　ないとき = 'when they have no energy'.
